name: Valley Questcaller
description: Whenever one or more other Rabbits, Bats, Birds, and/or Mice you control enter, scry 1. Other Rabbits, Bats, Birds, and Mice you control get +1/+1.
notes: First attempt found a real, previously-missed gap: a static's Affected$ field can be a comma-joined list of SEVERAL subtypes (here, 4: Rabbit/Bat/Bird/Mouse), same multi-clause shape trigger ValidCard$ already handles -- but the S: static handler's coarseType/qualifierFlags only ever read the FIRST clause, silently dropping every other subtype from the anthem ("Other Rabbits you control get +1/+1" instead of all 4 tribes). Fixed by splitting Affected$ the same way, building one modifier/tagger node per clause sharing the same delta/tag payload -- a systemic fix for every multi-type tribal anthem, not just this card. Verified: nodes H/I/J/K now cover all 4 tribes. In blb-success.json.
